# SunSpec Point Reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_point_reference.py. Do not edit by hand; rerun the script. -->

Every SunSpec point in the models the aGate reports, with its label and description, and the FranklinWH extension registers. Use it to look up what a point is and where it sits.

- **Labels, descriptions, types, units, scale factors (SF), access and M/O** (mandatory/optional) are from the SunSpec 2 model JSON shipped with **pysunspec2 1.3.6** (`sunspec2/models/json/model_<N>.json`), copied verbatim. A blank cell means the JSON has no value; where the JSON omits access or M/O, the pysunspec2 defaults (`R`, `O`, from `sunspec2/mdef.py`) are shown. Access `R`/`RW` is what the SunSpec model defines, not what the aGate accepts.
- **Models, start addresses and lengths** are from the [V12R02B60D00 snapshot](SUNSPEC_SNAPSHOT_2026-10-20_V12R02B60D00.md) (captured 2026-10-20). Addresses are Modbus **PDU addresses** (0-based, as sent on the wire); see [Register Addressing](FRANKLINWH_SUNSPEC_QUIRKS.md#register-addressing-pdu-addresses-modbus-and-the-sunspec-map).
- **PDU mirror (+40000):** on V12R02B60D00 the snapshot found the map mirrored at PDU 40000 (base-0 + 40000). Writes to the mirror are unverified (snapshot).
- A point's PDU address is the model header address plus the point's offset in the model JSON (`ID` is offset 0, `L` offset 1). Repeating groups show their first instance.
- The snapshot notes that the bridge export returned the points of models 705–712 as not implemented; their lengths are from the raw re-scan.
- **One Modbus client per aGate.** Stop other clients before reading.

The FranklinWH registers outside the SunSpec chain. sunspec2 can't see them; read them with a plain FC3 request at the PDU address shown, without the 40000 offset. The rows below are copied from [FranklinWH Extension Registers](FRANKLINWH_MODBUS_EXTENSIONS.md) (without its library column); that page is the authority for meanings, evidence and the notes on writing. The evidence terms (Documented, Measured, Inferred) are defined there.

| PDU | Name | Access | Type, unit | Meaning | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15500 | PVUse | R | uint16 flag | Proximal (aGate) PV installed | Documented |
| 15501 | apBoxPVUse | R | uint16 flag | Remote (aPbox/aHub) PV installed | Documented |
| 15502 | PVOutputP | R | uint16, W | Total PV power, all sources | Documented; measured |
| 15503 | — | R | uint16, W | PV proximal | Documented |
| 15504 | — | R | uint16, W | PV remote 1 | Documented |
| 15505 | — | R | uint16, W | PV remote 2 | Documented |
| 15506 | LoadActiveP | R | uint16, W (~100 W steps) | Home load | Documented; measured 2026-03-15 |
| 15507 | OnGridMode | R (writes undocumented) | uint16 enum | Operating mode | Measured 2026-10-21/22, V12R02B60D00 (1, 2, 3); see [15507 values](FRANKLINWH_MODBUS_EXTENSIONS.md#15507-operating-mode-values) |
| 15508 | SelfReserve | R (writes undocumented) | uint16, % | Self-consumption SoC reserve | Measured 2026-10-18, V10R01B04D00 |
| 15509 | TouReserve | R (writes undocumented) | uint16, % | TOU SoC reserve. **On V12R02B60D00 it holds the TOU reserve** (15 vs SC 8, matching the app). On V10R01B04D00 it repeated 15508 | Measured 2026-10-20/21, V12R02B60D00; the defect measured 2026-10-18, V10R01B04D00 (#63) |
| 15510–15511 | PVOutputWh | R | uint32 (high, low), Wh | PV energy, total (lifetime) | Measured: matches M502 `OutWh` |
| 15512–15513 | proxOutputWh | R | uint32 (high, low), Wh | PV energy, proximal (lifetime) | Measured: matches M502 `OutWh` |
| 16000 | — | R | uint16, W (~1 W) | Home load, high resolution | Undocumented; measured 2026-03-15 |
| 16001 | — | R | uint16, % | **Reserve for the active mode:** 100 in Emergency Backup, 15508's value in Self-Consumption (8), 15509's in TOU (15) | Undocumented; measured on V12R02B60D00, one read per mode, 2026-10-21/22 (#63) |
| 16002 | — | R | uint16 | 20 in both Self-Consumption and TOU on the reference site; matches the local API's `BBBackupSoc` | Undocumented; **meaning unconfirmed** (#63) |
| 15000–15043 | — | R | various | Mirrors of SunSpec values (e.g. 15020 = M713 `WHRtg`, 15036 = M713 `SoH` raw, 15025 ≈ M701 `LNV`, 15024 ≈ grid frequency) | Undocumented; measured. Writes accepted but discarded (probe 2026-03-08) |
